data.title: Signal Decoded | Gold and Bitcoin Rally Together - Technical Analysis & Key Levels
data.description: Both Bitcoin $Bitcoin (BTC.CC)$ and Gold $XAU/USD (XAUUSD.CFD)$ have been rallying while equities sell off and Treasury yields sit at 52-week highs. That is not a coincidence — it is a message. When sovereign debt sells off and the dollar weakens simultaneously, capital rotates toward assets outside the sovereign liability structure.
